context.description:
D&L Industries, Inc. (DNL) was incorporated on July 27, 1971, primarily as the holding company for a group of companies engaged in product customization and specialization for the food, chemicals, plastics, and consumer products Original Design Manufacturing (ODM) industries. 

The Company's business activities include manufacturing of customized food ingredients, oleochemicals for personal and home care use, and specialty raw materials for plastics. DNL also renders management and administrative services to subsidiaries and affiliate companies. The Company has four principal business lines: food ingredients; colorants and plastics additives; oleochemicals, resins and powder coatings; and consumer products ODM. 

DNL's major subsidiaries include Oleo-Fats, Incorporated; Chemrez Product Solutions, Inc.; First in Colours, Incorporated; Chemrez Technologies, Inc.; Aero-Pack Industries, Inc.; D&L Polymer & Colours, Inc.; Natura Aeropack Corporation; D&L Premium Foods Corp.; and Chemrez Technologies LLC. 

Source: SEC Form 17-A (2024)
